description: Superwall is a subscription infrastructure and paywall platform for consumer mobile and web apps. It provides entitlements, purchase and webhook infrastructure, analytics, SQL/query access, and tools for building and experimenting with paywalls.
summary: Superwall exposes a hosted REST API at api.superwall.com and an MCP server at superwall-mcp.superwall.com; both require authentication, and the docs also describe an editor-specific MCP connection flow whose concrete endpoint is not publicly documented.
